title: Sensor Fusion on Android Devices: A Revolution in Motion Processing
summary: David Sachs of InvenSense explains how gyroscopes, accelerometers and compasses work on their own and together, demonstrated on a modified Android handset. He covers sensor fusion algorithms and why rotation math such as Euler angles matters.
why: HN recommends it as the definitive talk on mobile motion sensing, including why integrating acceleration twice drifts so badly.

quote.text: I'm always happy to share this incredible lecture from many many years ago
